findings.found: the send port "SP_WarehouseSql" holds a value for Password in plain text, in its TransportTypeData; the value is shown here as ****
findings.fix: take the value out of the binding file, rotate it, and keep it in Azure Key Vault or behind a managed identity in the target

basis.text: BizTalk Server takes the passwords out of a binding file when it exports one, so they must be set again after an import, and the file may still hold sensitive data that must be kept safe

findings.fix: remove the send port if it is not used, or name the subscription it serves so the move can route it, such as a Service Bus subscription
